text: Do you like the taste of coffee?
description: A daily ritual for some. An acquired taste for others. Where would you fall?

text: Do you prefer TypeScript or JavaScript?
description: Same ecosystem, different preferences. A question about the tools people choose.

text: Are you a morning person or a night owl?
description: When do you feel most like yourself?

text: Would you rather live in a city or the countryside?
description: Busy streets, open spaces, or a little of both?

text: Do you prefer working alone or with others?
description: Think about the work you enjoy most, rather than the work you have to do.

text: Do you finish every book you start?
description: From cover to cover, or on to the next one?
